Before you give

A simple safety checklist.

How do I verify the payment details?

Request them through this page or the official contact route, confirm the beneficiary name is JOY Social Welfare Trust and retain the written instruction.

Will I receive a receipt?

Ask for the Trust's official acknowledgement or receipt and ensure the purpose and amount are recorded correctly.

Can I claim an income-tax deduction?

Only when the Trust's current approvals and your official receipt support the claim. The website does not make an automatic 80G or tax-benefit promise.

Can I donate from outside India?

Foreign contributions can be accepted only in full compliance with applicable foreign-contribution law and approvals. Contact the Trust before initiating any cross-border payment.
